data.body:
[P2] Preserve unresolved markers during example teardown

The example `settle-case` command calls `load_markers()` on a fresh `Cloud` before `close_case()`. If an accepted Invoke has no worker evidence and is absent from the first running-execution listing, this assignment discards its marker. Consequently, `close_case()` skips bounded discovery. A callback execution appearing afterward is only observed by `quiesce()`, never stopped, potentially exhausting the drain budget and quarantining subsequent cases. Carry unresolved invoked markers into teardown and retry their discovery within the existing bound. Add a regression exercising the `settle-case` CLI path with delayed visibility.
